name: Weehailes Playpark, Newhailes
description: Adventure play park for 3 to 12 year olds themed on Newhailes' library, with turrets, stained glass windows, slides, high walkways, playhouses, a zip line and a big sandpit. Open all year; children must be with an adult.
fee: Weehailes: £4 a child, £1 an adult, under-3s free, plus £4 a car to park. National Trust for Scotland members get in free.
